introduction.text: The Domus del Protiro (V,II,5) was a wealthy Roman house located in the V region of Ostia, notable for its elaborate architecture and the archaeological finds of classical statues.

history.description: The Domus del Protiro was built in the 3rd century AD.
The Domus del Protiro was a wealthy aristocratic residence in Ostia, featuring a central courtyard, a marble double niche, and a subterranean complex that may have served as a cult space.

design.description: The Domus featured a central courtyard with a basin, a double marble niche, and a subterranean complex accessed via a staircase in the portico.

art.description: Statues of Venus, Diana, Apollo, and a Genio with serpent and cornucopia were found in the Domus.
